scripts.version:sync: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); const count = execSync('git rev-list --count HEAD').toString().trim(); const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); pkg.version = '1.' + count; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n'); console.log('Version synced to', pkg.version);"
